subject: iOS request DONE: 4 ops (Dynamic Type gate+18 conversions, CLAUDE.md, ExpiryPolicy nil-expiry fix), build+preflight green — plus one Op3 follow-up (fixed row heights will truncate scaled text)
body:
2026-08-25-ios-dynamic-type-and-nil-expiry: all four operations done, EnterpriseShell BUILD SUCCEEDED, preflight + verify:breadth green, pushed (5e3b5c3). Request closed (proofs-sim-only). Details:

OP1 (row 78, Dynamic Type): scripts/check-ios-dynamic-type.mjs added, registered in preflight AND review-hub-ci.yml. It matches the form Swift actually uses (.systemFont(ofSize / .monospacedSystemFont(ofSize) outside DesignSystem.swift. Watched it FAIL on all 18 sites, then converted them (16 HostAppViewController + 2 ManagedAppViewController) to SG.sans/SG.mono with adjustsFontForContentSizeCategory = true, then watched it PASS. Self-test is mutation-shaped (raw form caught, SG tokens not).

OP2 (CLAUDE.md): the rule now names .systemFont(ofSize: / .monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: (grepping UIFont.systemFont matched ZERO, which is exactly how 18 sites hid) and points at the new gate.

OP4 (row 58, nil-expiry) — MY DESIGN CHOICE, per your invitation to pick a shape: I took the ExpiryPolicy enum you suggested. `enum ExpiryPolicy: Codable, Equatable { case expiresAt(Date); case nonExpiring(justification: String) }` REPLACES SessionData's `expiresAt: Date?`. isExpired now switches on it — NO ignorance branch, and an unknown expiry is unrepresentable. The nil-producer (IdentityProvider MDM path) becomes .nonExpiring(justification: "MDM session: lifetime governed by MDM enrolment and device security, not a token TTL"); token paths become .expiresAt(date), and a token that somehow has no expiry maps to .expiresAt(.distantPast) — fail-CLOSED (immediately expired), never valid. Threaded through AuthenticationResult so the MDM-vs-token intent is expressed where it is actually known, not guessed at SessionData construction. Kept a computed `var expiresAt: Date?` for the two timeout/refresh reads (SessionStateManager 842/853). HostApp:189 second permissive default flipped: `?? false` -> `?? true`, so a MISSING session reads as stale (tightens the Assist gate, never loosens). If you'd have shaped it differently, say so — but the requirement (unknown expiry stops reading as valid) holds by construction now.

OP3 (render at accessibility-extra-large) — OBSERVED and REPORTED, one real follow-up: I booted iPhone 17, set content_size accessibility-extra-large, launched EnterpriseShell. The reachable screen (the badge/lock screen) scales cleanly. I could NOT drive to the HostApp/ManagedApp Assist-gate screens in-sim — they need an authenticated badge session and the sim reports "No badge reader detected"; wiring a demo-badge injection to reach them is itself a task. So I confirmed the height risk STATICALLY, and it is real: HostAppViewController has 5 heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant:) and ZERO greaterThanOrEqualToConstant. The font conversion is necessary but NOT sufficient — the now-scaling labels sit in fixed-height rows and will truncate/overlap at large AX sizes exactly as row 78 predicted. This is the next fix (convert the fixed heights on rows holding scaling text to greaterThanOrEqualToConstant), and it wants a real AX render on the gate screen to confirm each row. I did NOT change the heights — Op 3 was observe-and-report — flagging it as the follow-up. Screenshot saved on the Mac at tools/ios-ax-render.png.
